# codex-0.163.0 verification

Status: Qualified anchor with bounded local-only store inspection.

Six compatibility cells passed on Codex 0.163.0 with gpt-6-astra on 2026-10-20; exec streaming remains the intentional skip. The question probe passed. Synthetic turns and later-process HERON-CODEX-1010 recall passed. Exec emits no compaction signal. A bounded local-only field lookup on qwen3.8-27b-mlx@8bit@pi/lmstudio observed at least two completed ContextCompaction items and at least two persisted compacted rows with nonempty replacement_history. Large rows were truncated: full histories, window links, previous_window_id and total counts were not inspected. Only derived structural metadata is included, not raw protected stores or encrypted content. The npm source remains @openai/codex.

The four app-server request schemas were generated by this CLI, not hand-edited. Native model/list captures cover visible models and includeHidden results. GPT-5.5 retired from the catalog on schedule (2026-10-14) and is absent from both lists; its vocabulary entry and effort ladder were removed at this anchor, with 0.162.1 keeping the historical evidence. Internal hidden models (gpt-reserve, codex-auto-review) are not added to HCN's curated vocabulary.

## Captured evidence

`seven.snapshot.json` and `questions.snapshot.json` are the smoke-suite receipts. `version-source.snapshot.json` records the published npm version observation. Fresh and question NDJSON files contain selected native identity/assistant/result records, preserved byte for byte. Configuration-bearing hook and user frames are omitted; these are excerpts, not complete native streams. Other native fixture fields are unchanged.

The live probes use synthetic data only. Lowered thresholds (model_auto_compact_token_limit=20000) do not establish full-capacity handling or lossless recall. A smoke pass alone does not prove native replacement-history installation. Old versioned fixtures remain intact.
